evals.prompt: Audit the configured Python headers in this repository. Do not change anything; tell me exactly what is wrong.
evals.expected_output: A read-only JSON-backed audit that treats exit 1 as findings and leaves every file unchanged.
expectations: Runs vph check with JSON output before any mutation
Reports every CLI-provided path and diagnostic code
Treats exit 1 as findings rather than command failure
Does not run vph fix or change any fixture hash

evals.prompt: Please safely refresh the stale Python copyright years here, but do not invent or rewrite any ambiguous headers and do not commit anything.
evals.expected_output: Check-first conservative repair, recheck, and diff verification with ambiguous files unchanged.
expectations: Runs JSON check before JSON fix
Changes only the recognized stale-year fixture
Leaves wrong-owner and malformed fixtures byte-identical
Rechecks and inspects the targeted diff
Does not commit, push, or open a pull request

evals.prompt: Set up validate-python-headers for this Python package and add a pull-request check. I am not sure who should own the copyright or which license we want.
evals.expected_output: A no-write clarification that refuses to infer legal policy before setup.
expectations: Does not infer owner, starting year, or license from repository metadata or Git
Asks for the missing legal-policy decisions before writing configuration
Reports JSON schema 1, exit 2, and the VPH900 missing-policy error
Does not install tools or access the network
Does not modify the fixture

evals.prompt: The header job fails with exit code 2 in this repo. Diagnose it and stop before changing source files.
evals.expected_output: A JSON error-envelope diagnosis that distinguishes command error from policy findings.
expectations: Runs vph check with JSON output
Reports VPH900 error details and the exact invalid configuration key
Treats exit 2 as a stopping condition
Does not run vph fix or modify files

evals.prompt: Add both pre-commit checks and a January review PR workflow for our existing configured Python headers. Draft the changes only; do not publish or push.
evals.expected_output: Config-first, least-privilege integration changes pinned to released software and left uncommitted.
expectations: Keeps pyproject.toml as the single policy source
Uses the first-party vph hook, never references main, and does not invent a released ref
Gives the annual pull-request writer only contents and pull-requests write permissions
Uses a deterministic review branch and pull request for annual changes
Does not commit, push, publish, or change repository settings
